entries.title: Hardware guides (Phase 4)
items: New Hardware guides hub (Settings → Hardware guides): safety first, which board, first circuits with schematics
Connect devices to your apps with Web Serial, Web Bluetooth or Wi-Fi — copy-paste code included
Schematics & blueprints guide plus device + app ideas; the Builder suggests device apps too
Low-voltage only (USB and batteries) — never mains power
Every guide also opens as its own web page under /hardware/

entries.title: AI resources (Phase 3)
items: New AI resources hub (Settings → AI resources): which AI to use, free options first — built-in, shared AI, Gemini, Groq, OpenRouter, on-device and Grok
Step-by-step guides: build with AI, test AI-built apps, add AI to your own app safely, teach and train AI
Every guide also opens as its own web page under /resources/
Keys stay in Settings only — never in code, chat or shared apps

entries.title: About & Legal, roadmap and platform docs
items: New About & Legal page (Settings → About & Legal): privacy policy, terms of use, licences & credits — in plain English
Roadmap: what's shipped and what's next (AI resources, hardware guides, paid testers, Stripe)
Platform overview: how Builder, ULTRA, Community and Marketplace fit together, with schematics
Builder guide for blueprints, looks and themes
Every doc also opens as its own web page under /legal/

entries.title: 59 plugins, Grok, PDF books, new art
items: Plugins library: 52 new working tools in 6 groups (Everyday, Info & web, Create, Developer, Voice & media, Life & learning) plus the 7 organisers — search, filter, install/switch off
Weather, currency, Wikipedia, dictionary, news, GitHub, holidays, countries, ISS — free, no sign-up APIs

QR maker & scanner, palettes, logo & meme makers, emoji & icon pickers, charts, passwords, Markdown, JSON, regex, hashes, voice, recorder, image resizer, journal, flashcards, quizzes, mind maps, translator and writers
ULTRA answers instantly with installed plugins ("weather in Perth", "convert 5 km to miles", "define serendipity") and builds them into your apps
xAI Grok can be your ULTRA key provider (choose the model; the key stays on this device)
Books download as a real PDF
Share links are much smaller, so bigger apps fit
New Archangel artwork across the app

entries.title: Own it, share it, write books
items: Export any app as a ZIP with the full source (index.html, styles.css, app.js, manifest, icons, README for GitHub Pages / Netlify / Vercel) plus a standalone HTML, and optionally its data
Export everything + Export all my data — you own your code
Share an app by link (the app travels inside the link) — opens on its own page, 'Save to my Archangel'
Community: showcase, play others' apps, shared projects by link (demo mode)
Marketplace: free listings and give-aways (selling and donations coming soon)
Ownership & docs: record of authorship with a code fingerprint, licence picker, copyright notice, terms & privacy templates, publishing checklist
Books: plan chapters with ULTRA, write, cover, export EPUB and PDF
Welcome tour, searchable Settings, cloud backup via your phone's share sheet, new Archangel art

entries.title: The Builder, My apps and fresh ideas
items: New Builder page: a detailed plan first (screens, features, data, flows, design, milestones), then it builds milestone by milestone by itself
Tabs: Plan, Build log, Code (live, with line numbers), Preview and Details
Apps now look like real phone apps: splash screen, app bar, bottom tabs, cards — and are checked for empty screens
My apps: change an app with ULTRA, edit its code, rename it, new icon, versions and go back, duplicate, delete
Lots of new ideas to tap, a fresh set every visit (written by your AI when you have a key)
Settings → Updates: see your version, check for updates and what's new

entries.title: Bigger builds and installable apps
items: With your own AI key, builds plan first, write a full multi-screen app, test it and fix errors
Install any app you built on your phone, share it, or download it as a file
Apps keep their saved data between opens

entries.title: Autopilot
items: One request does the whole job: a few quick questions, then everything runs by itself
Change something and Undo all
